concept.name: 24 Mornings of Dino Excitement
concept.creative_territory: A Christmas gift that creates a new moment of anticipation every morning
concept.audience_situation: A parent, grandparent, or relative choosing a Christmas countdown gift for a child who loves dinosaurs.
concept.consumer_truth: Many gifts create one peak reaction, while a countdown ritual gives the child a reason to return every morning.
concept.tension: The buyer wants Christmas anticipation to feel special, but an ordinary one-time gift or disposable daily treat ends too quickly.
concept.purchase_motivation: Create an easy, repeatable family ritual that combines surprise, dinosaur interest, collecting, and Christmas anticipation.
concept.big_idea: One Christmas gift creates 24 mornings of dinosaur excitement.
concept.hook_mechanism: Audience identification plus an emotionally recognizable open loop
concept.illustrative_hook: What if your child actually looked forward to every December morning?
concept.product_role: HERO — the calendar anchors the daily ritual

narrative_spine.purpose: Frame the desire for a more exciting December morning routine.
Introduce the 24-day dinosaur countdown calendar early as the mechanism.
Show multiple numbered doors opening across different mornings.
Show the dinosaur collection growing and reinforce 24 different surprises.
Show continued collecting, display, play, or verified tree use after a door is opened.
Present the verified current offer without fabricated urgency and invite the viewer to start the 24-day ritual.

demonstration_strategy: Open several numbered doors with real hands and the real product.
Reveal visibly different dinosaurs from those doors.
Build a growing lineup that makes the accumulation across 24 days understandable.
Show post-reveal collecting or play; show tree hanging only after the physical mechanism is verified.

allowed: verified current price and bundle structure
excluded: safety, material, age, health, and developmental claims

offer_role.launch_requirement: Verify price, bundle savings, and destination-page wording immediately before launch.

aip_continuation: A virtual countdown door invites the viewer to tap and reveal one dinosaur, then transitions to the growing 24-dinosaur collection and the verified bundle options.
landing_page_promise: The first product section should repeat the same 24-day, 24-dinosaur, no-repeat promise; show the same product design; and preserve the exact current price, $49 free-shipping threshold, and 30-day return period.
required_new_assets: Close-up footage opening at least three numbered doors
Footage showing several visibly different dinosaur figures
A complete 24-figure lineup or verified inventory image
Physical ornament-hanging footage if that use appears in the script
likely_failure_mode: The ad promises a daily emotional ritual but relies on static product renders, so the viewer never sees a convincing real reveal or accumulating collection.
cheapest_decisive_test: Produce one real-product opening sequence and test an emotion-led hook against a fact-led '24 doors, 24 dinos' hook while holding the offer, AIP, and destination constant.
